changes.title: Error Led to 400 Noncitizens Voting in New Jersey, Governor Says
changes.summary: A 2023 software glitch at the state’s Motor Vehicle Commission led to roughly 6,600 noncitizens being registered to vote during the Murphy administration, Gov. Mikie Sherrill announced.

changes.title: Software error improperly registered 6,600 noncitizens to vote, N.J. gov. says
changes.summary: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill said a preliminary analysis showed that fewer than 400 of the people registered that way went on to cast ballots.

changes.title: Thousands of Non-Citizens Registered to Vote in New Jersey Due to Software Issue
